title: MIUT 2026 Results: Esmiol and Hartmuth Rule Madeira
claims: The 2026 MIUT was the 17th edition, held on 25–26 April 2026, with about 3,500 runners from more than 60 countries and 700 volunteers.
Vincent Esmiol won the 2026 Legend in 12:48:03, with Gautier Airiau second in 12:56:52 and Tyler Green third in 13:02:10.
Katharina Hartmuth won the women's 2026 Legend in 14:54:53, with Helen Mino Faukner second in 15:50:00 and Jazmine Lowther third in 15:54:22.
The 2026 course had 7,165 m of positive gain and was about 8 km shorter than the 2025 course after the 2024 wildfires.
Conditions in 2026 were about 16°C overnight and low 20s°C by day, with alternating drizzle and sun on the high ridges.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 直读 TrailSight 赛后报道；Hartmuth 时间与官方成绩页差 6 秒，正文采用官方并保留差异。
